info.title: Arenova / Kridext API
info.description: REST API for the Arenova sports coaching platform — handles authentication, user management, coach profiles, bookings, reviews, tournaments, venues, community, notifications, and admin operations.

post.description:
Validates business rules (duplicate check) and tells the client which Firebase
auth method to use. The client then creates the Firebase user and sends the
ID token to /verify-firebase.

**Phone flow:** Use `firebase.auth().signInWithPhoneNumber()`, verify OTP, get ID token.
**Email flow:** Use `firebase.auth().createUserWithEmailAndPassword()`, call `sendEmailVerification()`, wait for user to click link, get ID token.

200.description: Instructions for the client to proceed with Firebase auth

post.description:
Unified endpoint for both phone and email authentication.
The client sends a Firebase ID token obtained after successful Firebase auth.
- For **phone**: Firebase Phone Auth OTP must be verified first.
- For **email**: Firebase Email/Password user must have `email_verified = true`.

If the coach exists, they are logged in. If not, a new account is created.

firebaseIdToken.description: Firebase ID token from client SDK

201.description: New coach registered and logged in

400.description: Missing token or email not verified

post.description:
Step 1 of the booking flow. Validates the slot, checks capacity,
and returns a Razorpay order for the frontend to initiate payment.
The booking is NOT created at this step.

childId.description: Child ID (required only for parent bookings)

orderId.description: Razorpay order ID to pass to checkout

razorpayKeyId.description: Your Razorpay Key ID for frontend checkout

post.description:
Step 2 of the booking flow. After the user completes payment on the frontend,
call this with the Razorpay response. Backend verifies the signature,
creates the booking, updates slot capacity, and credits the coach's pending wallet.

paymentSignature.description: Cryptographic signature to verify the payment

childId.description: Child ID (required only for parent bookings)

400.description: Invalid signature, slot full, or duplicate booking
